rows.en: <operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>Feels like he brought it on himself, huh.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>M-Mars, huh... That's a planet way out past Earth, right? That's amazing...
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>Well, it's nothing but rocks and snow, though.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Guess that's not too different from Siberia, then.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>Doesn't matter. That's a man's romance right there!
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>But this isn't the time to get excited.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>He's been fighting alone to save the person he loves. We ought to lend a hand.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Don't have to tell me twice.
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>Haah...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>What's wrong? You seem down, <color(4)>Harry<ce()>.

<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>You can talk about that in a situation like this... That's impressive, in its own way...
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>Getting split up in the middle of a honeymoon trip... that's really too sad.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>Gotta help out a guy who's fighting for the woman he loves.
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)>Being parted from family... is a sad thing. <color(4)>Asap<ce()>, please make sure you bring him back.

uncertainties.issue: 'Gain no danna wa...' trails off in source; kept trailing as 'Man, Gain really is...' without supplying the missing predicate.

Object of 'tsurete modoshite agete kudasai' (bring back) is omitted in source. Luxe is the King's daughter (established in preceding scene 4004583, not part of this task); 'him' inferred as King Sakomizu. Flag if a different referent was intended.

glyph_fixes.reason: font has no native-size lowercase j/q; 'just' -> 'really', meaning unchanged.

checked_decisions: 1/65 'Gain no danna wa...' trailing off, rendered 'Man, Gain really is...': source itself leaves the predicate unstated; no invented completion. Accepted.

1/259 object of 'bring back' (Asap being asked by Luxe): verified against preceding scene 4004583 with tools/scene_source.py. That scene establishes Luxe as King Sakomizu's daughter and frames the party's goal as stopping/confronting her father (16040/Luxe at 0/25-27: her father despaired over the changed surface world and is now attacking it out of obsession, please lend your strength; 12031/Ruri at 0/32-33: once we stop the Sakomizu army, let's reinforce). This is the only 'family member to be brought back' setup in either scene, so 'him' = King Sakomizu is supported by 4004583 and is kept.
remaining_uncertainties: 1/259: 4004583 supports 'him' = King Sakomizu but never states the referent explicitly in so many words (Japanese omits the object entirely, as noted by the original translator); flagged for awareness though the inference is well-grounded.
